appearance_facts.location: Map of US states colored by prevalence
appearance_facts.fact: The map uses a color gradient where dark red/maroon indicates lower values and yellow/cream indicates higher values, according to the legend.

appearance_facts.location: Legend on the right side of the map
appearance_facts.fact: The legend is a vertical bar labeled 'High' at the top (value 100) and 'Low' at the bottom (value 0). The top color is pale yellow and the bottom color is dark maroon.
Georgia is colored dark maroon, which corresponds to the bottom of the legend scale (near 0).
Rhode Island is colored dark maroon, similar to Georgia, corresponding to the bottom of the legend scale (near 0).
Delaware is colored pale yellow/cream, corresponding to the top of the legend scale (near 100).

appearance_facts.location: States like Idaho (ID) and New York (NY)
appearance_facts.fact: Idaho and New York are also colored pale yellow/cream, indicating high prevalence values.

printed_facts.fact: Title text: 'Prevalence of Species Z in US States'
Visible labels include GA, RI, DE, ID, NY, and others.

public_definitions: Routing criterion: Highest prevalence state in the dashboard

uncertain: Exact numerical prevalence values for each state are not printed on the map, only the color coding.
